title: Jade Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plants - Indoor/Outdoor Coleus
description:
Vibrant Cream & Green Foliage for Containers, Borders, and Houseplants!


KEY FEATURES
• Striking variegated cream and green foliage with pink speckles.
• Low-maintenance and heat-tolerant, perfect for busy gardeners.
• Versatile for mixed containers, hanging baskets, borders, or as a houseplant.
• Provides continuous colour from spring through autumn.
• Thrives in shade to partial sun, adding vibrancy to less sunny spots.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides 'Wizard Jade'
Colour: Cream, Green, Pink (foliage)
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn (foliage colour)
Growth Habit: Mounding, Upright


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial Shade to Full Shade (can tolerate sunnier locations)
Soil: Well-draining, fertile potting mix or garden soil
Watering: Moderate; water regularly, do not allow to dry out completely
Spacing: 25 - 36cm (10 - 14 inches)
Height: 30 - 36cm (12 - 14 inches)
Spread: 25 - 30cm (10 - 12 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10-11 (typically grown as an annual or houseplant in UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant plugs into larger pots or directly into garden beds once all danger of frost has passed.
• Provide consistent moisture, especially during warm weather, but avoid overwatering.
• Feed every two weeks with a balanced liquid fertiliser during the growing season.
• Pinch back stems to encourage a bushier growth habit and prevent legginess.
• If growing indoors, place in bright, indirect light and protect from cold draughts.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
